question: When will The Audacity to Podcast return from hiatus?
transcript_excerpt: Daniel J. Lewis announced he is taking a hiatus from The Audacity to Podcast until January or February 2027. He stated: 'I need to take a hiatus from The Audacity to Podcast for a little bit until January or February 2027' to focus on other projects including his software products Podgagement and PodChapters, and to attend conferences like Podfest in January and the National Religious Broadcasters Convention in February.

podcast_name: The Audacity to Podcast® - tips and how to start and grow profit in podcasting
question: What new features has Daniel J. Lewis launched in Podgagement?
transcript_excerpt: Lewis recently launched a Teams feature in Podgagement that allows podcast network operators to invite cohosts and team members with different access levels and permissions. He also launched a feature that brings download stats from podcast hosting providers and op3.dev into a unified interface. Additionally, he is developing sponsor kit features with live stats pages and downloadable PDFs to help podcasters monetize their shows, even those with smaller niche audiences.

podcast_name: The Audacity to Podcast® - tips and how to start and grow profit in podcasting
question: What improvements are coming to PodChapters according to Daniel J. Lewis?
transcript_excerpt: Lewis is developing a new transcript editor for PodChapters that allows users to drag and drop chapters directly within the transcript rather than working in the waveform editor. He is also implementing chapter resource pages, a concept he has been considering for years to enhance podcast chapters functionality.

question: Why is Daniel J. Lewis taking a hiatus from his podcast?
transcript_excerpt: Lewis explained that he is postponing The Audacity to Podcast to focus on other important projects and personal commitments. He stated: 'the problem I'm running into is that I'm doing these other things and getting so excited about the other stuff I'm building, I keep forgetting to set aside time for The Audacity to Podcast.' He is also homeschooling his 9-year-old son, teaching an AI class to homeschool high schoolers, returning to piano and karate, and working on completing milestones for Podgagement and PodChapters.
